goal: Create a network scanning tool that can discover devices and their open ports on a network
acceptance_criteria: The scanner should support CIDR notation for host ranges
The scanner should validate input parameters including ports and hosts
The scanner should handle socket operations with proper error handling
The scanner should output results in JSON format
All functions (scan_port, resolve_host, scan_network) are properly exported and accessible
Comprehensive test suite passes with proper socket handling and DNS resolution
